column1: DENGUE CASE REPORTING During  the  31st  week,  4391  suspected  dengue  cases were reported across all 26 districts, compared to 6004 cases in the  previous  week, reflecting  an  26.9% decrease. The Western Province accounted for 52.5% of total cases, with the Colombo Municipal Council (CMC) contributing  3.8%,  the  rest  of  Colombo  District  19%, Gampaha  District  21.2%,  and  Kalutara  District  8.5%. Outside the Western Province, notable case contributions  were  reported  from  Kandy  (8.9%),  Galle (5.6%),  Matara (4.7%),  Kegalle (3.9%),  Ratnapura (3.6%),  Kurunegala  (3.2%),  Puttalam  (2.7%),  Badulla (2.3%), and Hambantota (2.2%) (see Table 1) (compared to  the  previous  week,  colour  of  %:  red=increase,  green=decrease, blue=no change).
